name: Concatenating NifTi and Eventfiles
summary: Concatenating single-session, single-subject Nifti files into multiple-session, single-subject Nifti files for first-level GLM Analysis
description: Concatenates several preprocessed single-run task fMRI images of one subject into one 4D image with nilearn concat_imgs, and joins their events files by shifting each run's onsets after the last event of the previous run. Use it to prepare multi-run data for a first-level GLM. The code reads an 'auto_resample' config key that is not a registered parameter, and writes concatenated_img.nii.gz and concatenated_events.csv rather than the standard bold.nii.gz and events.tsv names.

inputs.description: Preprocessed task fMRI runs of one subject, in the order they should be concatenated.
inputs.requirements: Runs must share the same voxel grid unless resampling is enabled.

inputs.description: Events files (TSV with onset and duration) matching each fMRI run, in the same order.

outputs.description: Concatenated functional MRI bold.nii file; Will be used and passed into the First Level GLM App
Combined events table with onsets shifted to the concatenated timeline (concatenated_events.csv).
